summary: One contract for taking damage, so weapons never need to know about the Health component.
purpose: Lets hazards, weapons and area effects damage something without referencing Health directly. Anything implementing this can be hurt, whether it is a character, a destructible prop or a shield with its own rules.
whenToImplement: When something takes damage but should not use the stock Health component — a boss with layered armour, a shield that absorbs before health, an object that only reacts to certain damage types.

TakeDamage(float).contract: Apply the damage and do whatever follows from it. The caller does not care how it is stored or whether anything died.
TakeDamage(float).mustNot: Do not assume a caller checked IsDead first. Damage arriving at an already-dead target is normal and must be safe.

IsDead.contract: Whether this is out of the fight. Read by attackers and targeting code to skip it.
IsDead.mustNot: Do not make this expensive — targeting code reads it across every candidate, potentially every frame.

calledBy: Hurtbox funnels every hit into it, whether the hit came from a melee Hitbox, a hitscan shot or a projectile. Targeting strategies read IsDead to skip dead candidates.
useCases: A shield or armour layer that intercepts damage before health.
Destructible scenery with no health bar and no healing.
A boss part with its own damage rules.

gotchas.title: Health already implements it
gotchas.body: For an ordinary character there is nothing to write — add Health and you satisfy the contract.
